## What changes for players

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include a before/after example when useful.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Share synthetic screenshots for visible changes in chat or as review attachments; do not commit QA screenshots. Identify untested browsers or hardware when relevant.

For simulation or balance changes, include reproducible seeds and policy settings. For behavior-preserving refactors, explain how existing run and save behavior was compared.

## Compatibility and release notes

Explain save/progression compatibility and any migration or rollback considerations. Write "No save changes" when applicable. Publishing is a separate manual step after review and merge.

## Player patch notes

Update `src/content/patch-notes.ts` for player-visible changes, or explain why no entry is needed. Include any effect on existing expeditions.
